# `setup` — `/api/grove-setup`

The host moves their Grove to their own domain from Settings.

| Method | Path | Who may call | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | [`/api/grove-setup/address`](#get-api-grove-setup-address) | Host | The Grove's address, whether it's temporary, the server's IP, and any change of address in progress (host only). |
| POST | [`/api/grove-setup/check-domain`](#post-api-grove-setup-check-domain) | Host | Where a domain points now, and the DNS record to add (host only). |
| POST | [`/api/grove-setup/domain`](#post-api-grove-setup-domain) | Host | Asks the server's root helper to move the Grove to a domain (host only; servers set up with the installer). |

<a id="get-api-grove-setup-address"></a>
### `GET /api/grove-setup/address`

The Grove's address, whether it's temporary, the server's IP, and any change of address in progress (host only).

- Handler: [`address`](../../../backend/setup.py)
- Who may call: The host

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `address`, `host`, `temporary`, `server_ip`, `can_change`, `pending`, `result`

**Errors** (plus the [request checks](../../API.md#errors) every route makes)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 401 | Sign in to continue. | `user` |
| 403 | Host access required. | `administrator` |

<a id="post-api-grove-setup-check-domain"></a>
### `POST /api/grove-setup/check-domain`

Where a domain points now, and the DNS record to add (host only).

- Handler: [`check_domain`](../../../backend/setup.py)
- Who may call: The host

**Request body** (required, `application/json`, `DomainBody`)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `domain` | string | yes |  | at least 1 character; at most 260 characters |
| `email` | string | no | `""` | at most 254 characters |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `domain`, `addresses` (empty JSON list), `points_here`, `record` (JSON object with `type`, `name`, `value`)

**Errors** (plus the [request checks](../../API.md#errors) every route makes)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | Enter a domain name, not an IP address. | `clean_domain` |
| 400 | Enter a web address like grove.example.com. | `clean_domain` |
| 401 | Sign in to continue. | `user` |
| 403 | Host access required. | `administrator` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |

<a id="post-api-grove-setup-domain"></a>
### `POST /api/grove-setup/domain`

Asks the server's root helper to move the Grove to a domain (host only; servers set up with the installer).

- Handler: [`request_domain`](../../../backend/setup.py)
- Who may call: The host

**Request body** (required, `application/json`, `DomainBody`)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `domain` | string | yes |  | at least 1 character; at most 260 characters |
| `email` | string | no | `""` | at most 254 characters |

**Response**

- `202`: JSON object with `pending`

**Errors** (plus the [request checks](../../API.md#errors) every route makes)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | Enter a domain name, not an IP address. | `clean_domain` |
| 400 | Enter a valid email address, or leave it empty. | `request_domain` |
| 400 | Enter a web address like grove.example.com. | `clean_domain` |
| 401 | Sign in to continue. | `user` |
| 403 | Host access required. | `administrator` |
| 409 | A change of address is already in progress. | `request_domain` |
| 409 | This Grove was not installed with the server installer, so its address is set on the server (GROVE_PUBLIC_URL). | `request_domain` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |
